subject: Deployment mode for Elara - HIPAA / SOC 2 requirements
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alicia Morgan <alicia.morgan@elarahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Deployment mode follow-up - HIPAA & SOC 2 (Elara)

Hi Alicia,

Thanks again for the call earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment on deployment options given Elara's compliance constraints:

Recap from discovery:
- Elara will be processing PHI and requires a signed BAA.
- SOC 2 Type II evidence will be required as part of your vendor assessment.
- Audit window: you mentioned an internal audit in late May and a procurement decision target by end of Q2.

Deployment mode options we discussed (high level):
1) Hosted API (fastest): Redwood-hosted endpoints. Meets SOC 2 for our hosted offering and can support encryption-at-rest/in-transit. For PHI this requires a signed BAA and limited data retention options; not recommended if you require VPC-only egress or strict network isolation.
2) Dedicated capacity: Reserved GPU pools for Elara only (customer-isolated nodes). Provides stronger tenancy isolation and dedicated capacity for predictable throughput. We can support tighter network controls and longer log retention windows. Requires a contract for reserved capacity.
3) Private (VPC / on-prem): Full VPC or on-prem deployment with customer-managed networking and KMS/HSM integration. Best for regulated PHI workloads and the cleanest path for regulatory audits.

Next steps I propose:
- Send our SOC 2 summary and BAA template (attached) for your security team review.
- Marissa to coordinate a technical deep-dive on network/VPC controls next week.
- If preferred, we can prepare a Dedicated sizing estimate and pricing by end of week.

Can you confirm which deployment mode your security/procurement team prefers to prioritize (Hosted / Dedicated / Private)? If Private, any preference for VPC vs fully on-prem?

Thanks — happy to jump on a call with your security lead if that helps.

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference

From: Alicia Morgan <alicia.morgan@elarahealth.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Lee <tom.lee@elarahealth.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Mar 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Deployment mode follow-up - HIPAA & SOC 2 (Elara)

Dylan,

Thanks for the clear recap. A few clarifications from our side after sharing with security/procurement:

- We definitely need a signed BAA before any production data flows to a vendor.
- SOC 2 Type II evidence is required; can you provide the actual report or only a summary? Our procurement team will want the report (redacted where appropriate).
- Preference: Our security team is leaning toward Dedicated capacity or Private VPC. Hosted API is probably not acceptable for PHI unless you can guarantee network isolation and no co-tenancy — which I don't think is possible in your standard hosted offering.
- If we go Dedicated, we need details on network egress controls, encryption key management (customer KMS preferred), and whether we can have audit log exports for our SIEM.

Tom and I are available for a technical deep-dive next Wednesday (24th) or Thursday (25th).

Alicia
Director, Information Security
Elara Health

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alicia Morgan <alicia.morgan@elarahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Mar 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Deployment mode follow-up - HIPAA & SOC 2 (Elara)

Appreciate the quick response, Alicia,

Short answers:
- SOC 2: we can provide the SOC 2 Type II report. The standard practice is to share a redacted PDF under an NDA; I've attached the SOC2 summary for initial review. If you need the full report we can coordinate an NDAs/secure artifact transfer.
- BAA: attaching our BAA template for your legal team to review. We can go through DocuSign once terms are agreed.
- Dedicated: supports customer KMS integration (AWS KMS, GCP KMS, or HSM options) and we can ship audit logs (S3 export or secure syslog) to your SIEM. Network egress rules and private peering are supported for Dedicated and Private deployments.

Marissa, can you confirm your availability for the technical deep-dive on 24th/25th and whether you'll bring the VPC/Dedicated architecture doc?

Alicia, I'll set up a HubSpot deal record and a DocuSign envelope for the BAA to make the paperwork faster.

Thanks,
Dylan

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_Type2_summary.pdf, Redwood_BAA_template.docx

Thanks — I can run the technical deep-dive. I have the Dedicated architecture doc and a VPC checklist I will share ahead of the call. Proposed agenda:

2) Key management options and HSM/KMS integration — 10 min
3) Audit log export & retention capabilities (SIEM integrations) — 10 min
4) Q&A + action items (contracting / timeline) — 10 min

I can do Wed 24 Mar at 10:00 AM PT or Thu 25 Mar at 9:00 AM PT. Which works best?

Also, for your procurement team: I've attached a short PHI handling checklist that maps typical controls to deployment modes; it should help speed the decision.

Marissa Cole
